root.label: C++26 template features
root.note: Packs become indexable, creatable from objects, usable in friend lists and orderable in constraints.

children.label: Pack indexing
children.note: P2662R3: Ts...[N] picks a type and xs...[N] picks a value from a pack.

children.label: Constant size_t index
children.note: The index is a converted constant std::size_t below the pack length; out of range is ill-formed.

children.label: Non-deduced context
children.note: T...[0] as a parameter type cannot deduce T; the pack ends up empty and the call fails.

children.label: decltype result
children.note: decltype(xs...[0]) is the parameter's declared type; add parentheses for a reference.

children.label: Annex C break
children.note: void f(T... [1]) used to declare unnamed array parameters; now it is a pack index.

children.label: Structured binding packs
children.note: P1061R10: auto [a, ...rest] = e; binds the leftover elements as a pack.

children.label: One pack, any position
children.note: At most one ellipsis per declaration; it may be first, middle or last, and may be empty.

children.label: Templates only
children.note: The declaration must declare a templated entity, such as inside a template or generic lambda.

children.label: constexpr bindings
children.note: P2686 allows constexpr structured bindings; GCC 16 implements it only partially.

children.label: Variadic friends
children.note: P2893R3: friend Ts...; and friend A, B; are valid friend-type-declarations.

children.label: Non-class ignored
children.note: A friend-type-specifier that is not a class type is ignored, so int in the pack is fine.

children.label: No friend class Ts...
children.note: An elaborated-type-specifier naming a template parameter is ill-formed.

children.label: Passkey idiom
children.note: A class can grant access to a caller-supplied list of types without a helper.

children.label: Fold constraints
children.note: P2963R3: folds over && and || in constraints become fold expanded constraints.

children.label: Subsumption now works
children.note: (integral<T> && ...) is more constrained than (Num<T> && ...) when integral refines Num.

children.label: Same operator, same pack
children.note: An && fold never subsumes an || fold, because empty packs satisfy one but not the other.

children.label: Bool elements
children.note: Each element is its own atomic constraint and must be bool, which breaks some C++23 code.

children.label: GCC 16 gap
children.note: GCC 16 does not implement P2963; Clang 21 does.

children.label: New template parameters
children.note: P2841R7: concepts and variable templates can be template arguments.

children.label: Concept parameter
children.note: template<class> concept C takes a concept and may be used as a type-constraint.

children.label: Variable template parameter
children.note: template<class> auto V takes a variable template such as zero, not zero<int>.

children.label: Concept-dependent constraints
children.note: Constraints using an unknown concept argument are not eligible for subsumption.

children.label: Constant template parameter
children.note: C++26 wording renames non-type template parameters to constant template parameters.

children.label: Expansion statements
children.note: P1306R5: template for repeats its body per element at compile time.

children.label: Three forms
children.note: Enumerating over {exprs...}, iterating over a constant range, or destructuring an object.

children.label: Support
children.note: GCC 16 supports template for in -std=c++26; Clang 21 does not.
